kitDescription: Sky is a sniper-rifle Supporter (Iron, Burst I, 40s cooldown) built around Pierce support. Holding a full charge for a second gives her own shots Pierce for 40 seconds plus Pierce Damage ▲60% for 40 seconds, so with normal play her shots pierce essentially all fight. Her burst grants the whole team High Tension — Pierce Damage ▲15% for 35 seconds, stacking to 3 with cooldown reduction — and herself ATK ▲50% for 35 seconds; separately, every Full Burst entry (whether or not she cast it) gives all allies a flat ATK boost worth 20% of her own ATK for 10 seconds. The kit has a built-in penalty: when High Tension wears off — which happens every cycle without burst-cooldown reduction, since her 40s cooldown outlasts the 35s buff — the whole team takes Low Tension (ATK down by 10% of her ATK for 20 seconds) and she stuns herself for 20 seconds, firing nothing. She can also grant the team brief debuff immunity up to 3 times per battle.

redAssertions: UNMODIFIED (3 RED, mechanical): 'fixture sanity > runs the unit and actually produces Full Bursts' plus both S2a event-count assertions — the blind file passes onEvent at the top level of the runComp options instead of cfg.onEvent, so it records zero events and FB_STARTS is 0; a harness-wiring defect in the test, not an override divergence

ADAPTED (1 RED): 'S2b/S2c > no ATK-down is ever applied in the control fixture' — rests on the blind premise that sky never casts in controlComp because liter is also Burst I. The premise is false: first-ready selection hands sky the B1 cast whenever liter's cooldown is down at the chain (casts at 18.3s, 74.4s, 107.0s, 141.0s, 175.5s), and the negative casterAtkPct applications at 53.3s are exactly cast+35s — the kit-correct Low Tension lapse. RECON_ERROR, not a divergence; the same file's own structural assertions on that line (caster-scaled, -10, 20s, allies, selfStatusEnd /tension/i) are green against the shipped override.

gotchas.summary: Hold mode (default) credits EVERY full charge as a qualifying ≥1s hold, giving ~100% Pierce + 60% uptime from her first shot — the single biggest credit decision in the kit, and a play-style assumption the prose does not settle
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Full Charge is maintained for 1 or more seconds'; sim releases at full charge and never holds. Driver ships modes ['Hold','Release'] with Hold default; both S2b reviewers, S6 and S5 all independently chose the same every-full-charge reading (rapunzel-pure-grace precedent), so the default matches the blind convergence — but all four are the same model family sharing the prior
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs measurement — sky focus recording: is the Pierce buff icon up under auto play, and does her cadence pay the ~1s hold per charge cycle; pin first-proc phase and any cadence cost

gotchas.summary: Engine stun leaves burst casting unaffected, so she casts her 40s burst while Low-Energy-stunned; in-game a stunned Nikke likely cannot burst, which would stretch her real cycle toward ~55s and move every Tension timing
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Low Energy: Stuns for 20 sec'; engine convention (mast-romantic-maid). Flagged by fable-5-1 as report-not-act and carried verbatim as a ⚑ caveat with recipe; a related documented unknown is whether re-entering High Tension clears Low Tension early (20s vs ~5s effective stun)
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs measurement — recording where her burst cooldown returns during Low Energy: does she cast, when does fire resume, and does the recast clear Low Tension early

verdictRationale: All 8 kit lines are FAITHFUL (7) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (1, Defiant Spirit — unanimously unmodelable, recorded verbatim with the Low-Tension-interaction reconciliation the fable-5 reviewer demanded). The kit's penalty loop — the line a flattering model would drop — is fully alive: the new selfStatusEnd primitive fires Low Tension at real High-Tension lapses only (fixture B proves re-casts inside 35s suppress it, the exact case the burstCast+delaySec stand-in gets wrong), the 20s self-stun verifiably silences her fire, and the engine change is board byte-identical with its own 6-case pin whose discriminators were verified RED with dispatch disabled. Every load-bearing test has a named nearest-wrong counterfactual run in-file and diverging, so discrimination holds. The S5 convergence run is RED only for a harness-wiring defect in the blind file (onEvent at the wrong level) and one false fixture premise (that sky never casts in controlComp — she does, and the 'unexpected' ATK-down at 53.3s is the kit-correct lapse at cast+35s); both are RECON_ERRORs, and the blind file's structural assertions all pass against the shipped override. No change is required for GO. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: (1) the Hold default — all five agents (same family) converged on crediting every full charge as a ≥1s hold, which sets near-permanent Pierce uptime and is the kit's biggest unmeasured credit; (2) whether a stunned unit can really cast her burst in-game, which gates where every Tension window lands; (3) whether the burst recast at lapse+5s clears Low Tension early (20s vs ~5s effective stun). All three are ⚑-documented with recipes.
